name: Invoice Parser Agent (Drive -> PDF -> OpenAI -> Sheets -> Email)

parameters.text:
=You are an invoice parsing engine. Return only strict JSON—no prose, no explanations, no code fences, no leading language tags. The JSON must match the exact schema below, with keys in the same order. Dates must be ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). All numeric fields must be numbers (not strings). If a field is absent, use null. Infer currency from symbols (e.g., $, €, £) or common locale cues when possible. If line_total is missing per item, compute qty * unit_price.

Schema (order required):
{
"invoice_number": string,
"invoice_date": string, // ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD)
"vendor": string, // e.g., Acme Supplies Ltd.
"total_amount": number, // e.g., 210.00
"currency": string, // ISO 4217 (USD, EUR, GBP, etc.)
"due_date": string|null, // ISO 8601 or null
"line_items": [
{ "description": string, "qty": number, "unit_price": number, "line_total": number }
],
"notes": string|null,
"source_file_id": string,
"source_file_name": string,
"source_file_url": string
}

Normalization rules:

Convert any date formats you find into ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

Strip currency symbols and thousand separators from numeric fields; parse as numbers.

If currency is not explicitly stated, infer from symbols or context; otherwise return null.

If a section is present but empty (e.g., notes), set to null.

line_items should be an array; if none found, return an empty array [].

Output rules:

Output must be a single JSON object following the schema and order above.

Do not include extra keys.

Do not include any text outside the JSON (no “json” label, no backticks).

parameters.jsCode:
const data = $json; const li = Array.isArray(data.line_items) ? data.line_items : []; const liRows = li.length ? li.map(x => ` ${x.description ?? ''} ${x.qty ?? ''} ${x.unit_price ?? ''} ${x.line_total ?? ''} `).join('') : ''; const liTable = liRows ? `

Line Items

${liRows}
Description Qty Unit Price Total
` : ''; const html = `

📑 New Invoice Received

Date: ${data.invoice_date}

Vendor: ${data.vendor}

Invoice #: ${data.invoice_number}

Amount: ${data.total_amount} ${data.currency}

Due Date: ${data.due_date ?? '—'}

Source: ${data.source_file_name}

Notes: ${data.notes ?? '—'}

${liTable}

This email was sent automatically with n8n 🚀

`; return [{ subject: `📑 Invoice ${data.invoice_number} from ${data.vendor} — ${data.total_amount} ${data.currency}`, html }];
